Lemma
[The fundamental solution solves the heat equation]

↗ def:fundamental-solution-heat-equation

\group Heat Equation

For $t>0$ and $x\in \R ^n$, \[ \Phi _t(x,t)-\Delta _x\Phi (x,t)=0. \]
Proof

\sketch Direct differentiation gives

\[ \Phi _t=\Phi \left(-\frac n{2t}+\frac{|x|^2}{4t^2}\right), \qquad \Phi _{x_jx_j}=\Phi \left(\frac{x_j^2}{4t^2}-\frac1{2t}\right). \]

Summing over $j$ proves the identity.

□
